asbplayer.title: Sentence & Vocabulary Mining from Movies/Anime with asbplayer & Flama Connect
asbplayer.subtitle: Automatically create Flashcards with MP3 audio, video screenshots, and exact subtitle sentences with a single shortcut.
asbplayer.pillar_1_desc: Capture subtitle sentences, video screenshots, and precisely timed audio clips without manual clipping.
asbplayer.pillar_2_desc: Flama Connect acts as your central mining server via its compatible endpoint (/v1/anki-connect). Flashcards are saved directly into Flama anytime without Desktop Anki.
asbplayer.pillar_3_desc: Hover over video subtitles with Yomitan to automatically extract target words, readings, and dictionary definitions alongside audio and images.
asbplayer.download_desc: Install the browser extension or open the standalone asbplayer web application:
asbplayer.step_1_title: Step 1: Install asbplayer Extension or open Web Player
asbplayer.step_1_desc: Install the asbplayer extension on your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave) to mine subtitles on YouTube, Netflix, Crunchyroll. For local video files, open asbplayer.dev directly.
asbplayer.step_2_title: Step 2: Prepare "Sentences" deck & "Sentence Card" model on Flama
asbplayer.step_2_desc: Flama supports 1-click initialization of the dedicated "Sentences" deck and "Sentence Card" note type with 7 standard fields.
asbplayer.step_2_link: Go to asbplayer Settings to prepare deck
asbplayer.step_3_title: Step 3: Create an API Token on Flama Connect
asbplayer.step_3_desc: Visit /settings/asbplayer, select the "Rich Media Mining (mining-media)" preset to authorize sentence text, screenshot capture, and MP3 audio uploads in Flama Connect. Copy your API Key.
asbplayer.step_4_title: Step 4: Configure Flama Connect in asbplayer
asbplayer.step_4_desc: Open asbplayer Settings ➔ select "Anki" (the extension uses this standard protocol) ➔ toggle ON "Anki integration" ➔ paste the Flama Connect Server URL and API Key ➔ click "Test Connection" to verify connection with Flama.
asbplayer.step_4_note_desc: asbplayer uses the standard AnkiConnect protocol to communicate with external tools. Flama Connect serves as your standalone ingestion server compatible with this standard, saving all cards directly into Flama without Desktop Anki.
asbplayer.step_5_desc: Under Anki settings in asbplayer, select Deck "Sentences" and Note Type "Sentence Card" prepared by Flama Connect. Map the 7 canonical fields: Sentence, Word, Definition, Image, Audio, Source, URL.
asbplayer.step_6_title: Step 6: Mine while watching using Ctrl+Shift+X
asbplayer.step_6_desc: While watching video with Japanese subtitles, press Ctrl+Shift+X to capture the sentence, audio clip, and screenshot into Flama via Flama Connect. Hover with Yomitan first if you want vocabulary definitions included!
asbplayer.mapping_table_desc: Map asbplayer fields to Flama's Sentence Card model for optimal presentation:
asbplayer.rule_first_field_desc: The Sentence field is the first field and must contain text. Flama uses this field to prevent duplicate flashcards in the same deck.
asbplayer.preview_desc: Live preview of the flashcard created in Flama when you press Ctrl+Shift+X:
asbplayer.quick_link_settings_desc: Initialize deck/model, create API tokens, and manage integrations
asbplayer.quick_link_yomitan_desc: Combine with pop-up dictionary lookup on video subtitles for maximum efficiency
